Bronze.name: Cybera
Bronze.description: Cybera is Alberta's not-for-profit organization responsible for driving economic growth through the use of digital technology. Our core mandate is to oversee the development and operations of Alberta's cyberinfrastructure, the advanced system of networks and computers that keeps government, educators, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurs at the forefront of technological change.

Bronze.name: Arista
Bronze.description: Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, AI, campus, and routing environments. Our award-winning platforms deliver availability, agility, automation, analytics, and security through an advanced network operating stack, enabling organizations to build the infrastructure required for the AI era.

Bronze.name: AIMco
Bronze.description: AIMCo (Alberta Investment Management Corporation) is a high-performing investment manager that identifies leading opportunities around the world and delivers consistent results. As one of Canada's largest and most diversified institutional investment managers, AIMCo is responsible for the investments of pension, endowment, insurance, and government funds in Alberta.
